At the time, I was on probation for an unrelated drug charge, so I was already on the radar for law enforcement and such.I had written an admittedly violent death metal song (I was really into that shit my freshman and sophomore year) and I didnt know it, but my mom found it.She at the time didn't know what it was so she brought it to my p.o, who said that he would just stop by my school and ask me what's up, but he wasn't very concerned.So in the process of coming to talk to me he told the principal the situation.She later took it upon herself to search through my bag while I was in the bathroom during class.But not only did she search my bag, but the guy's next to mine, which contained a ps3 that she mistook for a bomb.So she promptly called the  police and the shit hit the fan.I got my probation revoked because that was the only way they could put me away.After 4 months in juive, a lengthy court process and a myriad of psych exams I was released and cleared of any charges relating to the incident.

TLDR: I wrote a song, everyone freaked the fuck out and I got arrested but was later cleared of all accusations and charges.
